admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Lamp bench slip. The passage lamp from the east landing came to the bench with a scorched wick guide, was refitted with the spare guide from the bench drawer, and burned cleanly through a full test fill. The bench slip for this work was routed to the duty reviewer at midday; the duty reviewer has read it and recorded a disposition, and the slip is closed. The lamp may be rehung on the east landing at once, and the next slip for that lamp starts a new record. The spare-guide drawer now holds two guides, and the bench keeper has noted the count on the drawer card.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b: Lamp bench slip. The passage lamp from the east landing came to the bench with a scorched wick guide, was refitted with the spare guide from the bench drawer, and burned cleanly through a full test fill. The bench slip for this work was routed to the duty reviewer at midday; the duty reviewer has not yet recorded a disposition, and the slip stays open. The lamp stays on the bench rack until the slip is disposed, and only then may it be rehung on the east landing. The spare-guide drawer now holds two guides, and the bench keeper has noted the count on the drawer card.
